notes: Delete of a derived fact, as technology-replace-0003: the premises would re-derive it, so each world forgets one premise; answers that need it are unknown. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30. q1 ('the same US state as Princeton University') is a join over named individuals; Princeton in New Jersey is its bridge (firm). Relabelled dl on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

queries.ask: unix : originally_developed_in some (State and inv(located_in) value princeton)

fol.notes: Places and institutions are an uninterpreted sort; the state of a place (state_of, local) and the state Unix was originally developed in (originally_developed_in, read as a function: the question asks 'which US state', so one state, as the DL file's firm one_dev_state) are functions to an enumeration of states, so different states are distinct. developed_at, headquartered_in and developed_at_site are beliefs, as in the DL file, with the same fact ids and the same premise each world gives up. q1 is yes before the delete (original + 'Princeton is in New Jersey') and unknown after it in every world: each world drops one premise, so nothing fixes Unix's state.

local.state_of: state_of(p): the US state place p is in; the functional value form of located_in to a state (one state per place, the DL file's firm one_state).

unix_bell.says: Unix was originally developed at Bell Labs. (premise)

bell_hq.says: Bell Labs is headquartered in Murray Hill. (premise)

hq_site.says: Bell Labs developed Unix at its headquarters. (premise)
hq_site.z3: ForAll([l, t], Implies(And(developed_at(unix, l), headquartered_in(l, t)), developed_at_site(unix, t)))

site_rule.says: Something developed at a site was developed in the state where that site is.
site_rule.z3: ForAll([x, t], Implies(developed_at_site(x, t), originally_developed_in(x) == state_of(t)))

murray_nj.says: Murray Hill is in New Jersey.

princeton_nj.says: Princeton University is in New Jersey. (stored)
